pundit.name: Clint Dempsey
pundit.take:
Bubba G's bettin' on DR Congo like he's got an uncle in Kinshasa, while Ghost Pepper's just tryin' not to get cooked — ain't neither strategy gonna stop France from dancin' on Spain in Texas.

Now, let's talk turkey: France has been puttin' in work, lookin' like they're ready to storm the Alamo in this matchup against Spain. Gunner's sittin' pretty at the top of the standings, and you'd think it's 'cause he drafted smart, right? Nah, man, this dude's got Morocco on speed dial like he thinks they've got a secret sauce that's gonna carry him to the promised land. Meanwhile, Devin's been spicy on the side with the USA and Norway, but we all know he picked Haiti 'cause he likes the sound of a good underdog story — even if it's got no legs. In this matchup, I'm bankin' on France teachin' Spain a lesson in footy finesse, all while Gunner acts like he planned every moment. Book it: France is gonna shine brighter than a Texas summer sun, and Ghost Pepper's left sweatin' in the shade.

pundit_takes.subtitle: Devin's hope rests on a spicy upset in Arlington.
